items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There is a man who has collected many airchecks, soundchecks, recording of you over the years. What is his name? His name is Carl...something? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Carl Smith.

ctx.x: There is a man who has collected many airchecks, soundchecks, recording of you over the years. What is his name? His name is Carl...something?

Smith, yeah. So, there’s this big treasure trove of your stuff, and clearly you listen to something in order to make a decision what to release. What is that process when you’re hearing yourself, how do you decide this is worth releasing...
